messages.content:
You improve the instructions of an extractor that fills a fixed schema from passages of law and of
technical documents by pointing at sentences. You are shown facts it extracted that a checker refused, each with
the checker's reason. Write ONE general instruction for the extractor, at most 30 words, that would have avoided
these failures. It must be general: no article or annex numbers, no names of documents, products, organisations
or persons. Answer with the instruction only, on one line.

Relation: requiresCheckAfter
Failure: missing_condition (9 facts)

response.text: When a sentence contains "if", "unless", "provided that" or "when", or states a trigger or exception, put that clause in the condition field. Keep the trigger out of the value, and never leave the condition empty.
